title: Legacy CC request morpheme adapter: normalize OA ChatCompletions payloads for streaming/tool calls/structured outputs
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Several legacy clients and third-party integrations still send/expect OpenAI Chat Completions (oa-cc) shaped payloads with subtle deviations that break Redwood's streaming + function-calling + structured-output flow (examples: role names like 'assistant' vs 'system' position, chunked SSE frames containing partial JSON function call arguments, and older clients relying on 'finish_reason' strings).

Goal: Implement an adapter component (request morpheme adapter) inside the ingress path that canonicalizes incoming oa-cc requests into Redwood canonical request shape and rehydrates outgoing responses so legacy clients observe the OA semantics they expect. The adapter must preserve streaming semantics (SSE/chunk framing), translate function/tool call signals bidirectionally, and validate/enforce structured-output schemas without breaking backward compat.

Scope & Requirements:
- Request normalization: map OA fields (messages array, name/role variants, temperature/top_p heuristics) to Redwood request model. Support older clients that use 'user'/'system' interchangeably in "name" or "role" fields.
- Streaming fidelity: keep token-level SSE frames with identical event types to OA where feasible; when Redwood inserts structured-output boundary events (e.g., schema-validation-error), the adapter must either map to an OA-compatible finish_reason or emit a supplemental event with clear vendor prefix.
- Function/tool calling: bridge OA function_call object (name/arguments) to Redwood tool invocation API. Handle partial argument delivery across stream frames by buffering KV segments and emitting a single coherent invocation when complete. Implement idempotency markers (X-Request-Id + invocation-seq) to make retries safe for stateful tools.
- Structured outputs: validate outputs against provided JSON Schema in-flight when requested. On schema violation, attach a best-effort 'content' fallback and surface a telemetry signal for downstream QA. Legacy clients should see a normalized stringified JSON in the assistant message body unless they opt into the new schema-error envelope.
- Error semantics: normalize error codes and finish_reason values to OA expectations while recording original error metadata in Redwood logs.
- Backwards compatibility toggle: feature-flag the adapter so Dedicated/Private customers can opt-out when they require strict Redwood-native semantics.

Milestones & Acceptance Criteria:
1) Adapter prototype (library + small proxy) with unit tests for mapping rules and streaming reassembly. Acceptance: unit coverage > 80% on mapping logic.
2) End-to-end staging test harness that replays legacy OA traffic and asserts preserved SSE event sequence and function invocation equivalence. Acceptance: zero dropped function-call arguments in 1000 trace replay.
3) Canary rollout to 10% of Hosted traffic for clients on the legacy compatibility list; monitor latency, error surface, and tooling invocation success rate. Acceptance: no >2x increase in 95th latency and function success rate >= 99%.
4) Docs: Add migration notes and an opt-out flag in Console.

Non-goals: Not changing OA public contract; not adding new developer-facing OA features. This is purely a translation/compat layer for compatibility and observability.

2025-01-18 - Michael: Initial prototype pushed to https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingress-adapters/pull/89. Prototype demonstrates buffering partial function_call arguments across SSE frames and re-emitting a single invocation event.

2025-01-21 - Review (Ravi Patel): Suggested making idempotency header name configurable and adding a backpressure circuit when buffer size exceeds threshold. Added unit tests for role-name mapping edgecases.

2025-01-27 - QA (Lina Morales): Created replay harness using anonymized production traces: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cc-replay. Found two cases where clients sent malformed JSON inside function_call arguments; adapter now attempts safe-parse with fallback stringification.
2025-01-30 - Security (J. Ortega): Confirmed no new secret material is stored; recommended audit log fields added to telemetry. security_review_required: false.
2025-02-02 - Michael: Integration tests passing in staging. Preparing canary plan and rollout dashboard (console-2025.02/canaries).
